about_subtitle: Crowdsourced Garbage Reporting & Community Action Map for Ahmedabad
about_mission_quote: “Don't just report the problem. Help solve it.”
about_story_desc: AmdavadSafai (અમદાવાદ સફાઈ) is an open civic-tech platform bridging citizens, community volunteers, Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), and the Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC). We believe true urban cleanliness requires radical transparency, localized accountability, and citizen action.
about_step1_desc: Citizens take a photo of a waste dump and tap the interactive map. The app auto-detects the AMC ward and GPS coordinates.
about_step2_desc: The complaint gets an AmdavadSafai tracking reference and is linked to the local Ward Corporator, MLA, and MP. Official filing stays with AMC CCRS 311 (155303).
about_step3_desc: Citizens can join or host Sunday Community Cleanup Drives (સફાઈ અભિયાન) to resolve persistent neighborhood blackspots.
about_step4_desc: Upload after-cleanup photos to create Before ↔ After sliders, earn Citizen Karma badges, and update the ward cleanliness score.
about_open_source_desc: Built with privacy in mind. No user tracking or mandatory account signup. Device identity is securely hashed on your browser.
